stop_condition: The corrected LESSONS.md entry is verifiably present in the working tree by checks that depend on it, every figure in both new entries reproduces against an independent measurement, and R2-F2 and R2-F3 are confirmed fixed.

findings.evidence: The entry opens 'the first two times this lesson was written it under-measured its own evidence'. Authoring 1 did under-measure (45 against a floor of 139). Authoring 2 did NOT: its figures were correct and complete at 139 across six specs -- I verified every one of them in round 2 -- and it failed by being destroyed by a hard reset and then falsely confirmed by a grammar-only suite, which is a different failure from under-measurement.
findings.description: A compression rather than an error, and non-blocking: the body of the same entry narrates the second failure accurately two sentences later ('that revert was done with `git reset --hard` ... The entry had to be authored a third time'), so a reader reaches the right account. Recorded at info rather than buried in prose because the entry's subject is measurement precision, and because a future reader counting instances of under-measurement from the opening clause would count two where the evidence supports one. No action required; noted for whoever next edits this line, given it cannot be edited in place once committed.
